anilist.description:
A Japanese-style ayakashi Cinderella story! "You're the bride I've been searching for all this time." The ayakashi and humans coexist in harmony. The ayakashi, having superior abilities and beautiful appearances, sometimes find their partner among human women, making them their "bride". The bride, in exchange for bringing prosperity, receives absolute love from the ayakashi. Yuzu is constantly compared to her sister, a bride of a demon fox, and is resented by her family every day. One day, when Yuzu just couldn't take things anymore, a man appears before her on a bridge. This man is the most beautiful man Yuzu has ever seen... and he's calling her his wife?! "Just be quiet and let me hold you." The most powerful, "cold-hearted" ayakashi is pouring his heart out for Yuzu?!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

episodes.title: Destiny
episodes.overview: Yuzu dreams of being loved by someone, since her family has always cast her aside.

episodes.title: Special Someone
episodes.overview: Reiya brings Yuzu to his home and announces that she is his bride.

episodes.title: Decision
episodes.overview: Karin returns to her parents' house to collect personal items and finalize her adoption by her grandparents.

episodes.title: Is Their Love for Their Brides Eternal?

titles.en: Is Their Love for Their Brides Eternal?

episodes.overview: As Reiya provides Yuzu with everything she needs, she is reluctant to become too dependent on him.

episodes.title: My Rival Is a Capable Secretary

titles.en: My Rival Is a Capable Secretary

episodes.overview: Yuzu begins working for Reiya and learns more about his relationship with his secretary Takamichi.

episodes.title: Touko and Nyankichi
episodes.overview: While Yuzu puzzles over her feelings for Reiya, Touko explains how she and Nyankichi got together.

episodes.title: Reiya`s Secret Lover
episodes.overview: Sakurako visits Yuzu and warns her not to get between Reiya and Takamichi.

episodes.title: The Bewitching Visitor
episodes.overview: Yuzu's sister and parents break into her grandparents' house and demand that she come home.

episodes.title: Self-Awareness
episodes.overview: Yuzu confronts Reiya about the rumors she's been hearing.

episodes.title: The Demon Banquet
episodes.overview: Yuzu attends the demon banquet, where she meets Reiya's parents and runs into her sister.

episodes.title: The Bride Sisters
episodes.overview: Years before Karin had such disdain for Yuzu, she adored her older sister.

episodes.title: The Ogre`s Bride
episodes.overview: Yuzu says goodbye to her sister forever and embraces her new life.
